en-US.longDescription: Radio-Sky Spectrograph (RSS) is a free Windows program for recording and reviewing radio frequency spectragrams. RSS records consecutive snapshots of the power in each of up to 512 frequency channels. Data can be shared in real time over the internet or saved to disk for review. RSS can be connected to a number of different software defined radios (SDRs) by utilizing the appropriate intermediary programs. While originally written to support the Radio JOVE project below 30 MHz, this software can be used at any frequency your radio supports.
en-US.name: Radio-Sky Spectrograph

zh-CN.description: 生成和查看无线电频谱图
zh-CN.longDescription: Radio-Sky Spectrograph（RSS）是一款免费的 Windows 程序，用于记录和查看无线电频谱图。该软件可连续记录多达 512 个频率通道的功率快照数据，支持实时互联网共享或本地存储回放。通过配套的中介程序，RSS 能够连接多种软件定义无线电设备（SDR）。虽然最初为支持 30MHz 以下的 Radio JOVE 项目开发，但该软件适用于您的无线电设备所支持的所有频段。
